description: Clinical Evidence: registered trials with version history, posted results, EU registry and regulatory records, linked publications and preprints, trial-design methodology, outcome switching and an explained strength-of-evidence view over the Science providers. Not medical advice.

vocabulary.question: clinical question (population, condition, intervention, comparator)
vocabulary.strength: explained evidence-base description, not a clinical conclusion

profiles.description: Surveillance dossier: a condition and a geography to each source's series with case-definition revisions, reporting and reference dates, vintages, MeSH/ICD alignment, boundary projection and explicitly cited trials and publications, sources side by side

vocabulary.reporting date: when the case or value was reported to the public-health authority (Meldedatum, GHO Date)
vocabulary.reference date: the date or period the value refers to (onset, Refdatum, reference year); never the reporting date
vocabulary.case definition: the source's definition revision in force on a value's reference date; a change is a marked break
vocabulary.kind: observation, estimate (with bounds where given) or model output; never presented as another kind
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series; earlier vintages stay addressable and pinned views turn stale
vocabulary.reporting delay: the source's own statement about incomplete recent periods; no nowcast is computed

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released by the requested reporting date; values without a reporting date listed apart
workflow_defaults.sources: side by side; nothing merged, averaged or preferred
workflow_defaults.thresholds: user-configured only; never derived or suggested
workflow_defaults.never: Published surveillance values as each source released them: no outbreak prediction, nowcast, completeness estimate, threshold suggestion or health advice; case-definition changes are marked breaks, never corrections.

profiles.description: Medicines regulatory timeline: a medicine or active substance to its authorisations, label revisions with section diffs and safety communications per jurisdiction, with the identity match used and explicitly cited trials, sources side by side

vocabulary.authorisation event: a dated grant, variation, supplement, suspension, withdrawal, refusal or status change as the regulator published it; a change is a new record
vocabulary.label revision: one version of an SPL (set id and version) or of EMA product information (EPAR revision), sections keyed by the regulator's section codes
vocabulary.section change: added, removed or changed section text quoted from both revisions
vocabulary.identity match: an RxNorm crosswalk (equivalent, broader, narrower) with evidence, release and review state
vocabulary.reporting counts: FAERS figures: reports mentioning a term, not incidence, rate or causation

workflow_defaults.as_of: the authorisation event and label revision in force on the requested date per jurisdiction
workflow_defaults.sources: side by side; nothing merged or preferred
workflow_defaults.never: Regulatory records quoted as each regulator published them: no prescribing, dosing or treatment advice and no efficacy or safety verdict beyond quoting the regulator.

profiles.description: Health-system capacity profile: a country or region to its hospital beds, health workforce and expenditure by financing scheme per source (WHO GHO, OECD Health Statistics, Eurostat), with definitions, definition breaks, comparability notes and release vintages, beside the pack's surveillance series for the same place

vocabulary.capacity indicator: one source's published series for a capacity domain (beds, workforce, expenditure) and place, keyed by the source's own code
vocabulary.definition: the publisher's definition in force on a value's reference period; a new edition is a marked break
vocabulary.comparability note: a reviewed statement citing both definitions where two sources' indicators differ
vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series; the as-of time selects the vintage then published
vocabulary.aggregate: a WHO region or an OECD or EU aggregate; shown as itself, never as a country

workflow_defaults.as_of: the vintage released at or before the requested date per series
workflow_defaults.sources: side by side; nothing blended, averaged or preferred; places never ranked
workflow_defaults.never: Published health-system capacity indicators (beds, workforce, expenditure by financing scheme) as each source released them, with definitions, flags and vintages, sources side by side: no ranking, performance or quality score, no harmonised, adjusted or re-estimated value and no combined metric.

profiles.description: Medical-device regulatory profile: a device, product code or manufacturer to its clearances, approvals with supplements, recalls, device identifiers, EU registrations and certificates as of a date per jurisdiction, and MAUDE report counts with the source's caveats

vocabulary.clearance: a 510(k) decision keyed by its K number, with decision code and date as published
vocabulary.approval: a PMA original keyed by its P number; each supplement is its own record and the approval lists the supplements published for it
vocabulary.recall: a recall keyed by its recall number; status and class changes are revisions
vocabulary.report count: a number of MAUDE reports received in a window per event type; never a rate
vocabulary.device identifier: a GUDID primary DI with its package DIs and published version

workflow_defaults.as_of: the revision in force at the requested date by the source's own date
workflow_defaults.sources: jurisdictions and sources side by side; nothing merged; identity only through reviewed matches
workflow_defaults.never: Regulatory records quoted as regulators published them: no safety-signal detection, no causality from adverse-event reports, no clinical advice and no patient data beyond what regulators publish.

Answers a device's regulatory history as of a date and report counts per event type with caveats, with reviewable identity across registries, citation links to Product safety, Medicines, trials, ownership and Products (degrading when those providers are absent) and subscription monitors. Contact persons, addresses and patient data are never stored (MD01). No safety-signal detection, no causality from adverse-event reports and no clinical advice.
